headline: Skechers Sued by Investors Over Alleged Valuation Suppression in $63 Deal
summary: Skechers faces a shareholder lawsuit alleging that company forecasts were improperly altered to suppress share valuation prior to agreeing to a $63 cash buyout transaction.
why: Skechers is a prominent global footwear brand. M&A-related shareholder suits can complicate closing timetables or trigger financial settlement liabilities.

impacts.name: Skechers U.S.A., Inc.
impacts.why: Litigation questioning merger terms adds legal scrutiny and uncertainty around deal closing.
